newsitem.title: USA: CRIIMI MAE increases securities investment.
newsitem.headline: CRIIMI MAE increases securities investment.

text.p: CRIIMI MAE Inc said Thursday that its increased investment in subordinated commercial mortgage-backed securities will "modestly" affect fourth quarter earnings, but the effect will be "far greater" in 1997 after a full-year benefit.
The company said that in the past several days CRIIMI MAE acquired an additional $104 million in subordinated commercial mortgage-backed securities.
It also expects to close additional acquisitions of the securities in early November and December, bringing its total investment for 1996 to about $265 million, it said.

The company said it used the proceeds from its third quarter convertible preferred stock offerings to pay down short-term financing on a temporary basis while it prepared for the closing of the commercial mortgage-backed securities (CMBS) investments.
That move resulted in recurring earnings available to common shares for the 1996 third quarter dipping below that of the second quarter, it said.

"However, now that we have invested or committed to invest the $65 million in aggregate net proceeds from our preferred stock offerings towards the purchase of subordinated CMBS, we expect recurring earnings to resume their anticipated growth," Chairman William Dockser said in a statement.
